notes.title: Devlog: #0 How we made Greed & Darkness
notes.content: [p][b]Greetings all![/b] [/p][p][b]To commemorate[/b] the recent release of our new and improved demo of [i]Greed & Darkness[/i], we've put together a Devlog of sorts, a peek behind the curtain on the development process. We discuss both the past and the future of the game, so if you are curious about what's coming, give it a watch![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K0Wd26089Zg&t=1s"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Lastly,[/b] we want to give a huge thanks to everyone for their support so far. We hope you'll stick around to see what the game becomes! And if you haven't yet played it, [i]what are you waiting for? The village needs more gold![/i][/p]
